anticipated store growth and earnings guidance
free cash flow before DXL capital expenditures
risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively quantified and transparent, but emphasizes non-GAAP performance metrics and includes standard forward-looking disclaimers that may soften interpretation of uncertainty. Underlying risks include recurring net losses, negative free cash flow, substantial secured borrowings, and continued dependence on the DXL store-conversion strategy despite improving sales and EBITDA.
